_comment: cockpit-api configuration. Copy to config.json and edit. All keys are optional; omitted keys fall back to the built-in defaults in server.py (DEFAULT_CONFIG). Paths below assume the Alpine chroot layout from CHROOT-LINUX-PLAN.md (/data/linux/...).

tls._comment: Self-signed cert is generated on first run via the openssl CLI (apk add openssl). Drop in your own cert/key and set auto_generate:false to use them instead.

modem._comment: AT channel. On the device this is /dev/smd11 (mode 0666). Point 'device' at a file/FIFO for offline tests, or set mock:true (or pass --mock) to use the fake modem.

stock_api._comment: The stock unauthenticated MiFi web API. Only allow-listed funcNos are ever forwarded (see stockproxy.py). With platform.prefer_direct:true this is only a FALLBACK - the cockpit reads the real system directly (uzplatform.py) so the stock app can be deleted.

platform._comment: DIRECT system access (uzplatform.py) replacing the stock :80 /ajax backdoor. When prefer_direct is true, WiFi/clients/MAC-filter/traffic/IP/DNS/device-info/netmode are read/written straight from the device (hostapd.conf, dnsmasq.leases, /proc, ioctl, getprop, AT) and the stock proxy is used only if a direct call fails. Set prefer_direct:false to revert to the old stock-proxy behaviour.

netmode_at._comment: Per-mode AT command to set the preferred RAT (net mode). This modem's exact mode-select command is unverified; leave empty to fall back to stock funcNo 1005 for SET (GET is always direct from the modem RAT). Fill in once verified on-device, e.g. {"auto":"AT...","4g":"AT..."}.

audio._comment: Voice audio bridge (virtual mic/speaker over IP). Off by default; auto-disables if tinyalsa/devices are absent. Runs on its own port. See audiobridge.py CONFIG constants for the tinyalsa device indices + tinymix routes to fill in during the hardware spike.

system._comment: Allow-listed system controls. Only services named here can be controlled via /api/system/service. Adjust commands to your chroot init (OpenRC rc-service shown).
